description: This source file defines the ImpactProjectDashboardController class, which manages impacted project data within the dashboard, including listing impact data, adding/editing impact items, and managing impact item costs. It handles project validation, user permission checks, form processing, and rendering appropriate views for impact data operations.

classes.name: ImpactProjectDashboardController
classes.description: Controller managing impact data related to projects within the dashboard, including listing impact data, adding new impact data entries, and managing impact items and costs.

methods.name: indexAction
methods.description: Lists impact data projects associated with a specific project, ensuring user permissions.

methods.name: listByFootprintAction
methods.description: Lists impact data projects filtered by footprint related to a project, with permission validation.

methods.name: addImpactDataProject
methods.description: Handles form processing to add a new impact data project, with optional footprint association.

methods.name: impactItemProjectAction
methods.description: Displays impact items associated with a specific impact data entry.

methods.name: addOrEditImpactItemAction
methods.description: Handles adding or editing an impact project item based on form submission.

methods.name: impactItemProjectDeleteAction
methods.description: Deletes a specified impact project item, with permission validation.

methods.name: impactItemProjectCostsAction
methods.description: Lists costs associated with a specific impact project item.

methods.name: addImpactItemProjectCostsAction
methods.description: Handles form submission to add a cost to an impact project item.

methods.name: removeImpactItemProjectCostAction
methods.description: Removes a specific cost from an impact project item, with permission validation.
